entities.name: PDU session status
entities.description: Indicates the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type that the message is sent over and are active within the UE.

entities.name: UE needs to indicate active PDU sessions
entities.description: Condition when the UE needs to indicate the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type and are active within the UE.

entities.name: Active PDU sessions
entities.description: PDU sessions that are currently active within the UE and associated with the access type used for message transmission.

relations.description: The PDU session status IE is included when the UE needs to indicate active PDU sessions.
The PDU session status IE indicates which PDU sessions are active within the UE.
